# Bookmrked

> Bookmrked is a personal place-collection app: save the spots worth remembering — coffee shops, record stores, galleries, hidden bars — mark them visited, and share collections with a public link.

Tagline: Save it. Visit it. Come back to it.

## What it does

- Users create themed collections of places (food and drink, coffee and cafés, bars and nightlife, art and museums, music and record shops, books and bookstores, travel and neighborhoods).
- Each place can be marked visited with a 1–5 star rating and a short note.
- Collections can be shared publicly via a link — no login required to view a shared collection.
- Free tier: up to 5 collections and 15 places per collection.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bookmrked.com/): Landing page describing the app and its purpose.
- Shared collections live at https://bookmrked/c/[share_token] — public, login-free views of a user's collection including visited status and star ratings.

## Contact
